title: Feasible High-Performance Plasma Flows for Stellarators
exact_target: Find a stable, efficient and buildable stellarator plasma-flow configuration, together with methods for exploring physically admissible designs.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006221 (OWR-14299090-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Mathematical Imaging and Surface Processing (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/5, pp. 209--274. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The report poses a design programme. Performance objectives, stability norm and engineering admissibility are needed to define a particular optimization problem.
